players.product: Exensio yield / manufacturing analytics and DFI for fabs

quarterly_data.signal: 10-K full-year 2025 results: total revenues were $219.0 million, up 22% from 2024. Platform revenue was $181.0 million, up 15%, driven by higher fixed fees associated with CV systems and the addition of secureWISE revenue, partially offset by lower perpetual license and DirectScan system revenue; Volume-based revenue was $38.0 million, up 70%, primarily from Gainshare, secureWISE data usage and Cimetrix runtime licenses. Gross margin was 72% (70% in 2024) and recurring revenue was 94% of total revenue (81% in 2024).
quarterly_data.figure: revenue $219.0 million (+22%); Platform $181.0 million (+15%); Volume-based $38.0 million (+70%); gross margin 72%; recurring revenue 94%

quarterly_data.signal: 10-K customer concentration (customers not named): three customers accounted for an aggregate 53% of 2025 revenue - Customer A 30%, Customer B 13% and Customer C 10% - versus two customers with 31% in 2024 and one customer with 35% in 2023. Two customers accounted for 64% of gross accounts receivable at December 31, 2025.
quarterly_data.figure: three customers 53% of 2025 revenue (A 30%, B 13%, C 10%); 31% (two customers) in 2024

quarterly_data.signal: 10-K remaining performance obligations: $254.2 million as of December 31, 2025, the majority expected to be recognized as revenue over the next two years; the amount excludes future sales-based or usage-based royalties. Installed scale: in 2025 nearly 8,000 pieces of semiconductor manufacturing equipment shipped with Cimetrix products enabled, and the secureWISE network connected over 300 manufacturing locations and over 100 equipment OEMs as of December 31, 2025.
quarterly_data.figure: RPO $254.2 million; nearly 8,000 tools shipped with Cimetrix in 2025; secureWISE over 300 manufacturing locations and over 100 equipment OEMs

quarterly_data.signal: 10-K capex and supply: 2025 investing cash flows included $32.8 million of purchases and prepayments of property and equipment primarily related to DirectScan systems (2024: $17.8 million). PDF relies on sole-source providers for certain software and for specialized parts for its DirectScan system.
quarterly_data.figure: DirectScan-related property and equipment purchases $32.8 million in 2025 vs $17.8 million in 2024

connects_to.relationship: Exensio analytics software and cloud-application development for Advantest test tools

contracts.signal: PDF's 10-K: in July 2020 PDF entered a long-term strategic partnership with Advantest that includes an agreement for PDF's assistance in developing cloud-based applications for Advantest tools leveraging its Exensio analytics software, a commercial agreement providing for the license to third parties of solutions combining Advantest's testing applications and the Exensio platform, and a 5-year cloud-based Exensio subscription that expired in July 2025. Platform revenue recognized from Advantest was $8.8 million in 2025, $12.7 million in 2024 and $9.0 million in 2023.
contracts.value: $8.8 million platform revenue in 2025 ($12.7 million in 2024)
